featured_reviews.name: Kalpana Dethe
featured_reviews.review_text:
I purchased a washing machine from Croma on 26 May 2026. Today is 30 May 2026, and the installation has still not been completed. This delay has been very disappointing.

What is even more frustrating is that the Croma staff are not cooperating. Calls are often not answered, and when they do respond, incorrect or misleading information is provided regarding the installation status.

I expected better customer service from a reputed brand like Croma. I request Croma to resolve this issue immediately and improve its after-sales service so that other customers do not face similar inconvenience.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Dear Kalpana Dethe,  we apologize for the inconvenience caused. We would like to know why you have rated us 1-star. Please email us your concern and registered contact number or order ID at customersupport@croma.com, so we can gather more details and work towards a solution.

featured_reviews.name: Tejas Dhuri (Tejaa)
featured_reviews.review_text: I had a really great experience at Croma. The staff was very polite,kshitija is  knowledgeable, and helped me choose the right product according to my needs and budget. They explained all the features clearly and didn’t rush the process. Their behavior was professional and friendly, which made the whole shopping experience smooth and comfortable. Really appreciate the excellent customer service!”
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Dear Tejas Dhuri (Tejaa),  we're glad to hear that you had a delightful time at our store! Our team takes pride in providing excellent service, and it's always rewarding to receive such kind feedback.

featured_reviews.name: Aishwarya Padwal
featured_reviews.review_text: We purchased a washing machine and TV from this store. The staff told us that earpods were free with the purchase. However, when we checked the bill, we saw that ₹2,500 was added extra for the earpods without properly informing us. This feels misleading and dishonest. Very disappointed with this experience. Also, no after sales services will help you Please be careful while getting something from here.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Dear Aishwarya Padwal,  we apologize for the inconvenience caused. We would like to know why you have rated us 1-star. Please email us your concern and registered contact number or order ID at customersupport@croma.com, so we can gather more details and work towards a solution.

featured_reviews.name: Ankesh Dhopat
featured_reviews.review_text: "I recently purchased this TV and I’m very satisfied with the performance. The picture quality is crystal clear with vibrant and natural colors. The sound quality is powerful, giving a theater-like experience at home. Smart features are smooth, fast, and easy to use. Delivery and installation were done on time without any issues. Overall, it’s excellent value for money. Highly recommended!" Thanks croma
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Dear Ankesh Dhopat, thank you for leaving us a wonderful 5-star rating! we are thrilled that you had an amazing experience with us at Croma. Your satisfaction is our utmost priority.

featured_reviews.name: Satish Bihade
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very disappointing experience with Croma. We purchased a new Lloyd AC, but the unit was delivered damaged and installation was not completed despite repeated follow-ups since morning.

No technician arrived on time and we were kept waiting throughout the day with no proper communication or solution. This caused serious inconvenience to our family, especially our small baby who suffered due to extreme heat.

We expected much better service from a reputed brand like Croma. This so pathetic experience.and mental harrasment from croma
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Dear Satish Bihade,  we're sorry to hear that your experience at our store was not up to par.  Please email us your concern and registered contact number or order ID at customersupport@croma.com. so we can better understand the issue and work towards resolving it.
